content: Theia backend leaves orphaned/zombie processes on shutdown: the plugin-host child keeps running after SIGTERM to the main backend process because the parent doesn't reap/cascade-kill it (eclipse-theia/theia #8946, #6685); same root-cause pattern documented across VS Code Server and code-server. Process-group/session based kill (not single-PID SIGTERM) is required to fully tear down.
